about.title: About Me
about.intro: I'm a Product Designer with a fullstack background and experience creating digital products end to end. My work starts with product, gains depth through technology and becomes UX/UI.
about.subheading: Product, technology and design working together to turn complex problems into viable and usable solutions.
about.journeyParagraph1: Based in Brazil, I design strategic digital solutions by combining product vision, fullstack development, APIs, data and user experience.
about.journeyParagraph2: I've had the privilege of working with leading companies like <1>Banco do Brasil</1>, <2>ImoBanco</2>, and <3>AevoTech</3>, where I've consistently delivered impactful design solutions.
about.journeyParagraph3: My approach combines product, user research, data reading, design systems, prototyping and technical collaboration to create clear, useful and scalable solutions.

newProject.title: Live Well Membership
newProject.subtitle: Complete redesign of an exclusive membership platform for vacation experiences on Florida's Gulf Coast (30A), focusing on privileged access and unique member benefits.
newProject.description: This case study presents the redesign of the Live Well Membership platform, which offers exclusive access and special perks to elevate vacation experiences in the 30A coastal region of Florida. The project focused on creating an elegant interface that reflects the relaxed coastal charm while facilitating access to membership privileges.
